shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Separate command panels, stat boxes, charts, and tables from the canvas.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Small hover and selection transitions in the rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Green action button for sync and create commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 150px; padding: 0 18px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #2f7d5b; color: #ffffff; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #235d43; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #dbeae0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Instrument Item
components.description: Dark translucent navigation row for an instrument in the research rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #eef5f0; text-align: left; font: 14px/1.3 Inter, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item strong, .ds-rail-item small { display: block; } .ds-rail-item small, .ds-rail-item em { color: rgba(236,244,239,0.68); font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Stat Box
components.description: Compact metric container used for selected-instrument metadata.
components.css: .ds-stat { min-height: 92px; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #d6dfd7; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(17,27,22,0.08); color: #132018; font-family: Inter, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat span { display: block; color: #66746b; font-size: 13px; } .ds-stat strong { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.1; }

narrative.overview: Quant Lab uses a restrained workbench system: a dark instrument rail, a pale research canvas, crisp green action states, compact panels, and tabular numerals.
keyCharacteristics: Dark persistent navigation for instrument context.
Pale canvas and white inspection panels for charts, tables, and metadata.
Green accent reserved for selected state and primary actions.
Dense but readable spacing tuned for repeated research workflows.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Green is used for state and action, not general decoration.

dos: Do keep the admin command strip compact and aligned.
Do preserve clear separation between browsing, syncing, and inspecting.
Do keep chart and table surfaces calm so data remains primary.
donts: Don't use decorative gradients, oversized marketing sections, or large hero compositions in the authenticated workspace.
Don't scatter accent green across inactive UI.
Don't allow control rows to overflow horizontally at ordinary desktop widths.
